Commentary.Commentary: So that brings us to the close of another one-sided affair. India continue to rule the roost while the Sri Lankans keep on slipping downhill. The visitors need to improve drastically if they are to challenge the hosts or else the one-way traffic will continue. Hope you enjoyed our coverage. Join us for the second T20I in Indore on 22nd December at 1900 local (1330 GMT). Till then, cheers and take care!

Man of the Match, Yuzvendra Chahal says he was struggling at the start but found his rhythm when he got the wicket of Tharanga. Adds he was mixing the googlies and leg spinners to the left-handers and it worked. Praises Yadav for the way he bowled and expresses that they revel in each other's success. Reckons they are used to bowling when the ball is wet and today they had enough on the board which allowed them to flight the ball.

Indian skipper, Rohit Sharma starts by saying he knew that the toss wouldn't make much of a difference. Adds they needed to bat well, be it first or second and is happy as the conditions remained same in both the innings. Praises Rahul for the way he batted. States that it is not an easy task when one returns to the side after a break. Lauds Pandey as well as he showed good character and played an ideal finishing knock and is short of words to describe Dhoni's innings. Reckons they weren't sure what score would be good, they just wanted to get as many as possible. On Yuzvendra Chahal and Kuldeep Yadav, he says they are the wicket-takers and every time they come out, they deliver for them. Has a word to say for Unadkat who provided an ideal start for them. Opines Bumrah and Pandya understand their jobs and he is really happy that they bowled well when the conditions weren't conducive.

Sri Lankan skipper, Thisara Perera is disappointed to be on the losing side despite winning the toss. Credits the hosts' batsmen for batting well and putting up a big total on the board. Feels 160-170 was gettable, even 180 would have been gettable but rues their batting department for another flop show. On the Indian spinners, he reckons his side needs to practice well to counter them. Adds they practiced hard in the net sessions and mentions that they don't have any more players to call upon apart from the fifteen who are in the squad. Hopes for a better show in the next game.
It's time for the presentation now. Here comes Perera first. Let's see what he has got to say...

Manish Pandey says he was anxiously waiting to go out and bat and is happy to make his opportunity count. Further says they got off to a good start and they just had to capitalize in the middle. Reckons he had a good outing against Sri Lanka the last time he played against them. Informs he looks to take his time at first and then attack when he is set. On the tips Dhoni gave to him, he states that Dhoni asked him to move across which helped him deal with the wide yorkers. Ends by saying it is a good start for them and hopes for a similar show in the next game.

Well, Sri Lanka, they will be really kicking themselves at the moment. Firstly, they leaked too many at the death while bowling and then once again their batsmen were found wanting by the Indian spinners. They meekly surrendered without even showing any fight. From 46/2, they got bowled out for a scanty 87, handing India their biggest win in this format in terms of runs. That shows how much they need to improve in the years to come. We have Manish Pandey with Sanjay Manjrekar, let us hear him out...

A dominating performance from India tonight! Yes, they had runs on the board but still with the fear of the dew factor looming around, they had to be at their best with the ball. The Indian spin twins, Yuzvendra Chahal and Kuldeep Yadav once again came to the fore and spun their web to leave the Sri Lankan batsmen stunned. Their variations and ability to thrive under pressure has been the talking point for a while now. Together they shared the spoils by bowling 8 Overs, giving just 41 Runs and picking up 6 Wickets between them. Once they did the damage, Hardik Pandya decided to take the advantage and came back well in the end to get three wickets to his name. Not to forget Jaydev Unadkat who with his cutters, outfoxed the batsmen and provided his team an ideal start.

OUT! And Hardik Pandya wraps things up! This is the biggest T20I win for India in terms of runs! That's someway to get going in the series! Ball - Pandya bowls the cutter, it's on the shorter side to which Fernando backs away and chips it straight to Unadkat at point who takes a dolly. INDIA WIN BY 93 RUNS!
Fuller in length and outside off, Vishwa just drives it through covers and comes back for the second.
Nuwan Pradeep is the last man in.

OUT! Good catch from Rahul! Pandya gets his second! Length delivery, angling in on middle. Chameera swings it across the line and it goes towards deep square leg where Rahul moves a couple of steps to his right and takes it neatly. Can Pandya wrap it up in this over?
This one cuts back in from a length and pings DC high on the thigh pad.
Short of a length delivery on off, Dushmantha looks to cut it away but is beaten all ends up.
Length delivery, angling in from around off. Chameera tries to defend it away from the body but seems to have gotten an inside edge on the pads.
Remains in the crease and tucks it through mid-wicket for a run.
FOUR! Runs are coming but it is perhaps too late. Full toss outside off, Chameera slices it behind point to pick up back-to-back boundaries.
FOUR! On a length, Chameera clears his front leg and hits it off the bottom part of the bat over mid off for a boundary.
Fullish delivery, eased to mid on.
Slower short delivery, Chameera goes for a front foot pull but gets beaten.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Vishwa Fernando strides out next to bat. Also, Jasprit Bumrah comes back into the attack.

OUT! What a reflex catch from Pandya! He lands it on a length around middle, Akila backs away and flat-bats it straight down the ground. Pandya in his followthrough sticks his hands out and plucks it magnificently. Akila can't believe and starts to walk back.
Wide! Bangs in a short ball on middle, it's too high and the umpire calls it a wide.
Looks to go through the off side but gets an inside edge through square leg for a single.
Played through mid-wicket region by the batsman. They manage to come back for the second.
Back of a length outside off, mistimed it straight to cover.
Backs away again and carves it over point for a single.
Back of a length delivery, Akila backs away and hits it straight to mid off.
Comes forward and pushes it towards cover. Kuldeep ends his spell with terrific figures of 4-0-18-2!
Gets across and works it down to long on for a single.
Dushmantha Chameera comes out to bat.

OUT! Top edge! Kuldeep Yadav tosses it up around off, Perera gets down to slog sweep it but there is a bit of extra bounce and some turn off the deck which means the ball takes the top edge and goes high up in the air. Dhoni calls for it and takes it easily.
Googly, it's dropped short, cut to deep backward point for a single.
The batsman has swept that one through the leg side. They pick up a single.
Gets down to play the reverse sweep but fails to connect.
Flat and short outside off, slapped through covers for a single. Chahal finishes his spell with figures of 4-0-23-4! Just brilliant!
Nearly a wicket! Bowls a wrong 'un, Dananjaya somehow tries to keep it out but gets an inside edge past the leg stump. The ball goes towards fine leg and they take three.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Perera comes down the track and pads it away. He crosses over but the umpire calls it a dead ball as the batsman didn't offer any shot.
Fuller on the stumps, jammed out towards long on for a single.
Akila Dananjaya is the new man in!

OUT! Stumped! A 4-fer for Chahal! What a spell from him! In every over he has picked up a wicket, that is exceptional from Yuzi! He sees Perera giving a charge and so he smartly bowls a googly wider than the batsman's reach. Thisara swings across the line and gets beaten. Dhoni behind the stumps is quick to take the bails off and claims a stumping. It's taken upstairs and replays show the Sri Lankan skipper is well short. Can Chahal pick up a 5-fer here?
Has Chahal got another? Dhoni has whipped the bails off and he is confident. When he is, we know the batsman is in danger.
On middle and leg, worked away through mid-wicket for a single.
Flatter outside off, Thisara Perera doesn't play at it.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman. Two runs added to the total.
Sees Kusal Perera coming down the track and fires it on the pads, jammed to mid-wicket for a single.
Thisara Perera, the skipper is the new man in! 123 required from 58 ball. What can Perera do here?

OUT! Kuldeep opens his account as well! Tosses it up around middle, it's the wrong 'un. Shanaka tries to go big down the ground but is undone in the flight. Miscues it high in the air towards long on where Pandya comes sprinting in to take a safe catch. Half the side back in the hut for Sri Lanka.
Shortish and outside off, Perera camps back and cuts it uppishly over point for a single.
Bowls a slider now, Dasun misses his flick shot and is hit high on the thigh pad. Chahal's figures read - 3-0-17-3!
A loud shout for an LBW! Chahal bowls a googly, Shanaka doesn't read it at all. Gets pinged on the pads and the Indians appeal. The umpire turns it down as he spots an inside edge.
Flatter and around leg, clipped to deep square leg for one.
Short and outside off, punched off the back foot through cover for a single.
The batsman gets an inside edge and the ball hits him on the pads.
Tossed up on off, a front foot push towards cover.
Dasun Shanaka is the new man in!
OUT! Stumped! Asela comes and he perishes! This wasn't the cleanest of the takes from MS but India wouldn't mind it at all. Chahal continues to weave his magic, third one for him!
Around middle and leg, swept straight to the man at 45. Another good over from the spinner.
Bowls a leg spinner around off, turning away, Kusal looks to reverse paddle this but is beaten. Good take by MS again.
Fuller around middle, AG dinks it down to long on for one.
Drops it short on middle, KP camps back and short-arm jabs it to deep mid-wicket for one.
A loopy full toss, dipping in on the southpaw who pull/sweeps it through square leg for a couple. 50 comes up for Sri Lanka but at some cost, says Harsha Bhogle on air.
Flighted delivery outside off, Asela leans across and flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Slower through the air, landed full outside off. Asela eases it down to long on for a single.
Around middle and leg, hit down to long on. The batsmen want two but won't get it.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball.
Asela is off the mark straightaway. Pushes it down to long on for one.
Asela Gunaratne strides out to bat next. The asking rate is close to 11 RPO. Can he strike a few to get his team back on track?

OUT! Caught and bowled! Chahal gets his second! Mathews' struggle at the crease comes to an end. Yuzvendra tosses it up around middle, it stops a bit on the pitch. Angelo lunges forward to drive but ends up chipping it straight back to the bowler who accepts the catch gleefully. He dismissed him in the third ODI and does so again. Sri Lanka are in huge trouble now.
Drops it short and outside off, punched to sweeper cover for a single.
The rope is out to take the dew off. It's really wet out there. Also, Yuzvendra Chahal is called back into the attack.
Perera looks to slog but gets it off the inside edge towards Rohit at short fine leg who fumbles and concedes a single.

Another good stop from Chahal! Loopy ball outside off, Kusal gets down and reverse sweeps it past Dhoni. The Indian leggie gives it a long chase from backward point and does well to stop it inside the rope. Two taken.
The batsman works it down the leg side. The batsmen have run through for a single. Mathews is off the mark finally!

Comes down the track and nudges it through mid-wicket for a single. Dhoni shouts - BOWLER! BOWLER! BOWLER! The fielder in the deep does that as he was quick to throw the ball to Kuldeep to deny them another run.
Superb stop, Chahal! Perera gets down and nails the reverse sweep but Chahal at backward point got his body behind the line to make a clean stop. 6 dot balls in a row now!
Googly to begin with. Perera looks to cut but then at the last moment jabs it towards mid-wicket.
Kuldeep Yadav to roll his arm over now.

Four dots in a row and just a single from the last over of the Powerplay! Mathews hangs back and keeps this length delivery out on the leg side. All of a sudden, the Indians have put a lid on the scoring rate.
And again! Another slower delivery on the stumps, Angelo digs it out.
Nicely done by Jasprit! Rolls his fingers over the ball and Mathews just tries to drive it away from his body. Is beaten all ends up.
Back of a length delivery outside off, steered away towards cover-point. Another dot.
Length delivery on the stumps, worked towards mid on for a quick single.
Length delivery on middle, defended from within the crease.
Jasprit Bumrah comes into the attack.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground. 10 from the first over of Chahal and the wicket of the in-form Tharanga.
Angelo Mathews is the new man in. 142 needed from 91 balls.

OUT! Caught down the leg side! Excellent take from Dhoni, he dropped him in the previous over but takes a good one to limit the damage! To be honest, this wasn't a wicket-taking delivery by any means. Chahal bowls it down the leg side, Tharanga looks to sweep it away but all he manages is a tickle and Dhoni is quick to take it to his right. Replays show there was a clear edge there.
The ball is down the leg side but the batsman still goes after it.
Deep square leg comes in.
SIX! That's gone all the way! Tharanga comes down the track, isn't to the pitch of the ball either but trusts his power and goes bang over long on. Tremendous hit that.

FOUR! Nicely done! Chahal bowls it around middle and leg, Upul Tharanga knows the man is inside the circle on the leg side and so he takes his chance. Sweeps it cleanly over the man at short fine leg for a boundary.
Beaten! Flatter delivery from Chahal, skids a bit, Tharanga makes room to go through the off side but gets beaten. It wasn't far from kissing the off pole.

Yuzvendra Chahal is brought into the attack. We saw the Sri Lankan spinners finding it difficult to grip the ball. Let's see what Chahal can do. Dhoni, Sharma and Chahal are seen discussing something.
Slower delivery, fuller in length, Perera drives it uppishly but it falls short of the man at point. Brilliant over from Jaydev, just two off it.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot. The batsmen have run through for a single.
The bowlers are finding it really difficult here. More sawdust is being sprayed near the landing area...
Another slower one, Jaydev is executing it really well. Tharanga chips it back down the track but the bowler was moving to his right and then tries to go to his left but the ball falls down safely.

Was there an edge? Yes, there was! Dhoni has dropped it! Slower delivery which takes Tharanga by surprise. He is opened up a bit as the ball goes off the handle of the bat, kisses the thumb and goes to Dhoni who is a bit late to react. The ball hits his mitts and falls down. Initially, it seemed like there wasn't an edge but Snicko confirms. Then it seemed like the ball didn't carry to Dhoni but even that is wrong. It did, so Tharanga gets a life.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Perera taps it in front of point and scampers through for a single.
On a length and outside off, Perera stands in his crease and defends it down.

Back of a length delivery on middle, Tharanga looks to pull it away. Gets it off the higher part of the bat but the ball falls safely near the mid-wicket region as the batsmen take two. 11 runs came from the over.
Good length delivery on middle, UT moves across the line and paddles it through backward square leg for a couple.
SIX! Ahhh! Mind blowing! Length delivery on middle, Tharanga just waits for it and dispatches it over mid-wicket. All power as the ball sails over the fence for a maximum.
Back of a length delivery on middle, Upul Tharanga unfurls a short-arm jab but finds the man at mid on.
Tharanga got some medical attention in the previous ball. He had an issue with his left thumb but he is fine now. Meanwhile, long leg comes inside the circle.
Bangs in a short ball on middle, Tharanga ducks under it.
Back of a length delivery on middle, punched wide of mid on for a single.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot. Lovely start from Unadkat, 5 runs and a wicket from it.

Edgyyy! Jaydev has his tail up. After bowling a slower one, he bowls a pacy delivery to Perera. Kusal is opened up a bit and gets a leading edge which flies past the man at backward point for a single.
Kusal Perera walks out next.

OUT! Got him! Unadkat strikes in his very first over! Maiden T20I wicket for him and he has his hands aloft in celebration! Bowls a slower one, just outside off, Dickwella is ages early into the shot. His bottom hand comes off and as a result he ends up mistiming it high in the air towards extra cover. KL Rahul moves a few steps to his right and grabs it easily. Dickwella departs cheaply.
Sawdust is being sprayed near the bowler's landing area...

Good thinking from Dhoni! Back of a length outside off, Dickwella comes down the track to hit big but gets beaten. The ball goes towards Dhoni and seeing Dickwella slipping on the turf, he tries to run him out. Misses his target but Dickwella made it in.
Slower back of a length delivery outside off, dabbed straight to short third man.
FOUR! Welcome Unadkat, says Dickwella! Jaydev bowls a length delivery, angling in, Niroshan walks across and just chips it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Jaydev Unadkat is asked to bowl from the other end.

Overthrows! Sri Lanka wouldn't mind this at all. Manish Pandey what have you done? Rohit Sharma shakes his head! Very full around off, Dickwella digs it out towards the off side and sets off for a single. Pandey from point, comes charging in, gets to the ball and fires an unnecessary throw at the striker's end. Chahal is the one backing up. He gets a bad bounce as the ball hits his left knee and rolls away to the fence for a boundary.

In the air... clears the infield. Length delivery on middle, Dickwella comes down the track and lofts it without any timing. Much to his delight the ball goes over the infield and he picks up a couple.
Good length outside off, tapped in front of cover for a single.
Fuller and nipping back in a touch, Dickwella slogs wildly across the line but gets a thick inside edge down to fine leg. Bumrah has a long ground to cover and he does well to keep them down to one.
Fuller in length and outside off, Tharanga leans into it and drives it off the meat. Iyer at cover-point half stops it which allows Upul to get off the mark.
Sri Lanka are away! Short of a length delivery to begin with. Dickwella just runs it down to third man for a single.

We are back for the chase. The Sri Lankan openers are Niroshan Dickwella and Upul Tharanga. Watch out for the former, he has it in him to provide a rollicking start. Hardik Pandya is asked to open the bowling for India. Let's go...
